description: Annotates a copy of a Nextflow pipeline with moirai provenance hooks from an agreed per-process spec.
instructions: Read the agreed discovery record and the module scripts. Run nextflow_annotate_spec, show nextflow_annotate_diagram to the user, then nextflow_annotate_apply and nextflow_annotate_validate. Try a process with nextflow_annotate_preview on fixture values before applying. Never edit the source tree; never call exit in a hook; a failed validator verdict goes to the Corrector section of the skill.
